title: 真题演练 · wish 虚拟语气
hint: 本组题目按本单元语法点与词池生成/匹配;答错后点击「回溯语法课」复习 wish 虚拟语气。

questions.q: I wish I ___ how to swim.
questions.analysis: 对现在的愿望用过去时 knew。

questions.q: She wishes she ___ the early bus yesterday.
questions.analysis: 对过去的遗憾用过去完成时。

questions.q: We wish you ___ here with us tomorrow.
questions.analysis: 对将来的期待用 would + 动词原形。

questions.q: ___ only I had locked the door!
questions.analysis: If only 表强烈愿望,后接虚拟语气。

questions.q: He wished he ___ more careful in the interview.
questions.analysis: wished 本身过去时,从句时态再回落一层,用 had been。

questions.q: 判断对错:I wish I am taller.
questions.analysis: 应改为:I wish I were taller.。对现在的愿望用过去时,be 用 were。
